 04:45 
 Copied 
 Copied 
 Pop-music icon Lance Bass joins TODAY to talk about his new children’s book, “The Legend of Mrs. Claws,” about a cat who takes an unexpected ride on Santa’s sleigh, beginning a holiday adventure. He details his obsession with the Christmas holiday season, shares how he gets his kids in the spirit, and reflects on how NSYNC fandom has evolved over 30 years. Nov. 18, 2026
